archer.initialPrompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: production-ready TRANSPARENT animation sprite sheet for a Sengoku tower-defense PC game. Create ONE adult male Japanese archer character as a semi-realistic detailed 3D render: dark indigo lamellar armor with restrained gold edging, blue helmet, tan trousers, sandals and shin guards, Japanese yumi bow and quiver. Elevated isometric three-quarter camera; character faces toward the lower-right in every frame. Soft neutral illumination, readable at game scale.
Canvas MUST be landscape 1536 x 1024 pixels, organized as exactly 6 equal columns and exactly 4 equal rows, a regular 24-frame grid of 256 x 256 cells. The grid is invisible. Place one complete character in EVERY cell. Fixed camera, fixed scale, fixed costume, same adult face and bow across all frames. Keep feet/contact baseline at 90% of EACH cell height; body centered. Each frame including extended bow and fallen corpse entirely inside its cell with transparent margins. No cropping and no crossing into neighboring cells.
Frames run left to right. Row 1 top: idle breathing cycle in six subtly DIFFERENT poses, body lift, shoulder and bow sway. Row 2: six DISTINCT WALK poses, 1 left foot forward right back, 2 left-foot contact and right heel raised, 3 passing right leg forward, 4 right foot forward left back, 5 right-foot contact and left heel raised, 6 passing left leg forward; arms and pelvis move naturally while carrying bow. Row 3: six DISTINCT ATTACK poses, 1 reach for arrow, 2 nock arrow and lift bow, 3 pull string halfway, 4 full draw aimed lower right, 5 release arrow with bow recoil, 6 lower bow and recover. Row 4 bottom: six DISTINCT DEATH poses, 1 flinch, 2 buckle knees, 3 kneel, 4 fall diagonally, 5 land on side, 6 motionless corpse on ground. Non-graphic, no blood. The last two corpse poses must still fit their own cells.
This is a genuine animation sequence, not repeated still images: limb positions, foot contact, bending and attack phases must differ. Render ONLY the 24 character cutouts on an actual transparent RGBA background. No floor, no opaque background, no shadow puddles, no grid lines, no text, numbers, labels, borders, UI, watermark, or extra characters.
